resources.string: Every photo has been looked at. New photos are checked as you add them.
Name a face once; the whole group and every later photo follow.
Removes every face measurement and suggestion from this phone. People you tagged stay tagged.
All face data on this phone will be deleted. Photos and the people tagged on them are not affected. Turn face suggestions on again to start afresh.
No faces waiting for a name.
Nothing. Yaadein has no internet permission, no accounts and no analytics. It cannot send your data anywhere.

Your people, memories, photos, videos, voice recordings, notes and settings stay in the app\'s private storage, encrypted. With a Yaadein PIN, the keys can only be unlocked with your PIN or fingerprint. Android cloud backup is switched off for this app.

Face suggestions (off by default) find and compare faces on the phone with a bundled model; the face measurements are stored only in your encrypted vault and can be deleted in Settings → Face suggestions. Smart polish uses Gemini Nano on the phone only where it is already installed. Voice memories use the microphone only while you record. Reminders and the widget are scheduled on the phone and hidden on the lock screen.
Only when you choose to: sharing a reel, a picture or PDF of a memory, a password-protected family pack, or a password-protected backup (by hand, or weekly to a file you picked).
Uninstall the app, or use Settings → Storage → Erase everything. There is nothing else to delete.
Yaadein is for all ages: no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.
If the app ever crashes, a short technical note is saved here — on this phone only. You can share it with the developer if you want help.
Install a newer Yaadein APK, keeping all your memories
Choose the newest Yaadein APK file you downloaded. If it is newer than this one, it is installed over the current app.
Yaadein is already up to date
This file is version %1$s, the same as the installed version %2$s.
This file is version %1$s, older than the installed version %2$s. Nothing to update.
The file is a different app, or a different edition of Yaadein. Choose the Yaadein debug APK.
Android only installs it after removing the current app, which would delete your memories. It was not installed. Use an APK from the same build source.
The file couldn\'t be read as an app. Download it again and try once more.
Updating keeps everything: Android only replaces the app itself when the new version has the same name and signing key. Making a backup first is still a good habit.
Your family’s memories, kept close and kept private
Yaadein is a private memory book for the people you love. Keep photos, videos or just a few words about a day, and come back to them as a timeline, as each person’s story, or as a reel to share.
Add photos and videos, or write a line like “Goa trip 2024” and Yaadein turns it into a memory. Old days are easy too: pick a month, a year or “around Diwali”.
Scroll your timeline, open anyone’s story, see what happened on this day in past years, or shake your phone for a surprise memory.
Turn a person, a year or a single day into a vertical reel with music, ready for WhatsApp status, Instagram or a birthday wish.
Everything stays on this phone, encrypted and behind your fingerprint or PIN. No account, no ads, no internet, no tracking.
Make one password-protected backup file and restore it on your next phone, with every photo and story intact.
Select photos in Google Photos or any gallery, tap Share, choose Yaadein, and a new memory opens with them already added.
Android needs a one-time permission before Yaadein can install an update from a file. Tap Allow updates, switch on “Allow from this source”, and press back. The update then continues by itself.
Yaadein closes for a moment while it updates. Tap the “Yaadein updated” notification to come straight back; your memories stay.
Tap to open. All your memories are here.
Yaadein PIN. Your memories are encrypted with it.
No separate PIN. Memories stay encrypted on the phone, but not with a PIN only you know.
Strongest: your memories get encrypted with your PIN.
Yaadein will open with your phone\'s PIN, pattern or fingerprint, and your Yaadein PIN will stop working. You can set a new one any time.
Fingerprint wasn\'t switched on. Try again.

Every week, Yaadein saves an encrypted backup to one file you choose, for example in your Google Drive folder. If this phone is lost, your memories are not.

This family pack has %1$d memories and %2$d photos or videos. They are added next to yours; nothing is replaced. People with the same name are joined.
